items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I'll often know him speak of me and Mac Murray.

ctx.x: No, no. Another father he played with was Charles Elgar. I knew him. He's still up there. He's an officer in the union. He's vice president. He's vice president. Many years. They were just about the same age. My father might be one or two years older than he. A fellow by the name of Ralph Marniegu. That was another one in that old brass band in that area. Ralph Marniegu. That was a soldier. Who I saw. I heard him mention out. I said Crusto. That's the name. Diddy Chandler. Diddy Chandler came up right around in…

Oh yes. We never didn't know much about Mac Murray. You happen to know what his real name... Some people say his first name was Mac and his last name Murray? No, that was his last name. His last name was Mac Murray. Now, I'm trying to think what was his first name.
